items.title: Women’s Self Defense Class
items.description: Learn how to keep yourself safe! Commissioner Monica Matteo-Salinas invites you to a free women’s self defense class. Saturday, September 19 9 AM – 12 PM Miami Beach Police Department 1100 Washington Avenue Register at bit.ly/4cbzBdl . For any further questions, email monica@miamibeachfl.gov.
items.location: 1100 Washington Ave, Miami Beach, FL 33139, USA

items.title: Miami Beach Baila! by Commissioner Joe Magazine
items.description: LOCATION & TIME UPDATE To make sure we can dance rain or shine, we have partnered with “Andres Carne de Res”, a beautiful indoor location for our first “Miami Beach ¡Baila!” In addition, we are hosting a FREE Beginner Bachata Lesson from 6:00 PM – 6:30 PM. MIAMI BEACH ¡BAILA! FREE, social dancing for our residents of all ages! Salsa | Bachata | Merengue | Kizomba | Zouk Date: Sunday, September 20 Time: 6 PM – 9:30 PM Location: Andres Carne de Res 455 Lincoln Rd Miami Beach JOIN OUR WHATSAPP GROUP For more info: 786.697.9182
items.location: Andres Carne de Res, 455 Lincoln Rd, Miami Beach
